(std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n427: \n428:     val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n429:     Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n430:     val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n431:     if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n432: \n433:     Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n434:     val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n435:     if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n436: \n437:     return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n438: }\n439: \n440: // ============================================================================\n441: // Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n442: // ============================================================================\n443: \n444: // Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any \n454:     return octree.applyToTris(from, to, [&](size_t idx, const Triangle& tri) {\n455:         if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) return false;\n456: \n457:         val_t dist = Vec3& normal) {\n471:     val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n472:     if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n473:     return std::max(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n474: }\n475: \n476: // Compute form factor Kij Octree& octree,\n480:                   RandomGenerator& rng) {\n481:     const Triangle& triI = triangles[idxI];\n482:     const Triangle& triJ = triangles[idxJ];\n483: \n484:     // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n485:     if (triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;\n486: \n487:     val_t kij = ZERO;\n488: \n489:     for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n490:         Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);\n491:         Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);\n492: \n493:         if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, octree, idxI, idxJ)) continue;\n494: \n495: cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n501: \n502:         if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n503: \n504:         kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n505:     }\n506: \n507: Vec3 {\n    val_t x, y, z;\n\n    constexpr Vec3() : x(0), y(0), z(0) {}\n    constexpr Vec3(val_t x, val_t y, val_t z) : x(x), y(y), z(z) {}\n    explicit constexpr Vec3(val_t v) : x(v), y(v), z(v) const { return {x * s, y * s, z * s}; }\n    Vec3 operator/(val_t s) const { return {x / s, y / s, z / s}; }\n    Vec3 operator-() const { return {-x, -y, -z}; }\n\n    val_t dot(const Vec3& o) const { return x * o.x + y * o.y + z * o.z; }\n    Vec3 cross(const Vec3& o) const {\n        return {y * o.z - z * o.y, z * o.x - x * o.z, x * o.y - y * o.x};\n    }\n\n    val_t squaredNorm() const { ============================================================================\n// Triangle-Box Overlap Test (for octree construction)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Separating axis test for triangle-box overlap\nbool triangleBoxOverlap(const Vec3& boxCenter, const Vec3& boxHalfSize, const Triangle& tri) {\n    // Translate triangle to box center\n    Vec3 v0 = tri.a - boxCenter;\n    Vec3 v1 = tri.b - boxCenter;\n    Vec3 v2 = tri.c - boxCenter;\n\n    // Triangle edges\n    Vec3 e0 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e1 = v2 - v1;\n    Vec3 e2 = v0 - v2;\n\n    // Test box normals (AABB axes)\n    auto minMax3 = [](val_t a, val_t b, val_t c) {\n        return std::make_pair(std::min({a, b, c}), std::max({a, b, c}));\n    };\n\n    auto [minX, maxX] = minMax3(v0.x, v1.x, v2.x);\n    if (minX > boxHalfSize.x || maxX < -boxHalfSize.x) return false;\n\n    auto [minY, maxY] = minMax3(v0.y, v1.y, v2.y);\n    if (minY > boxHalfSize.y || maxY < -boxHalfSize.y) return false;\n\n    auto [minZ, maxZ] = minMax3(v0.z, v1.z, v2.z);\n    if (minZ > boxHalfSize.z || maxZ < -boxHalfSize.z) return false;\n\n    // Test triangle normal\n    Vec3 triNormal = e0.cross(e1);\n    val_t d = triNormal.dot(v0);\n    val_t r = boxHalfSize.x * std::abs(triNormal.x) +\n              boxHalfSize.y * std::abs(triNormal.y) +\n              boxHalfSize.z * std::abs(triNormal.z);\n    if (std::abs(d) > r) return false;\n\n    // Test 9 edge cross products\n    auto testAxis = [&](const Vec3& axis) {\n        val_t p0 = axis.dot(v0);\n        val_t p1 = axis.dot(v1);\n        val_t p2 = axis.dot(v2);\n        val_t r = boxHalfSize.x * std::abs(axis.x) +\n                  boxHalfSize.y * std::abs(axis.y) +\n                  boxHalfSize.z * std::abs(axis.z);\n        auto [minP, maxP] = minMax3(p0, p1, p2);\n        return !(minP > r || maxP < -r);\n    };\n\n    Vec3 axes[3] = {{1,0,0}, {0,1,0}, {0,0,1}};\n    Vec3 edges[3] = {e0, e1, e2};\n    for (const auto& axis : axes) {\n        for (const auto& edge : edges) {\n            Vec3 crossAxis = axis.cross(edge);\n            if (crossAxis.squaredNorm() > EPSILON) {\n                if (!testAxis(crossAxis)) return false;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Octree for Spatial Acceleration\n// ============================================================================\n\nconstexpr size_t MAX_OCTREE_TRIS = 8;\nconstexpr val_t MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE = 0.5f;\n\nclass Octree {\npublic:\n    Vec3 minBound, maxBound;\n    Vec3 halfExtent, center;\n    std::unique_ptr<Octree> children[8];\n    std::vector<size_t> triangleIndices;  // Indices into the global triangle list\n    const std::vector<Triangle>* allTriangles;  // Pointer to all triangles\n\n    Octree() : allTriangles(nullptr) {}\n\n    void build(const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles) {\n        allTriangles = &triangles;\n        if (triangles.empty()) return;\n\n        // Compute bounding box\n        minBound = triangles[0].a;\n        maxBound = triangles[0].a;\n        for (const auto& tri : triangles) {\n            for (const auto* v : {&tri.a, &tri.b, &tri.c}) {\n                minBound.x = std::min(minBound.x, v->x);\n                minBound.y = std::min(minBound.y, v->y);\n                minBound.z = std::min(minBound.z, v->z);\n                maxBound.x = std::max(maxBound.x, v->x);\n                maxBound.y = std::max(maxBound.y, v->y);\n                maxBound.z = std::max(maxBound.z, v->z);\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Collect all indices\n        std::vector<size_t> allIndices(triangles.size());\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < triangles.size(); ++i) allIndices[i] = i;\n\n        buildNode(allIndices, minBound, maxBound);\n    }\n\nprivate:\n    void buildNode(const std::vector<size_t>& indices, const Vec3& nodeMin, const Vec3& nodeMax) {\n        minBound = nodeMin;\n        maxBound = nodeMax;\n        halfExtent = (maxBound - minBound) * 0.5f;\n        center = (minBound + maxBound) * 0.5f;\n\n        // If few enough triangles or too small, make this a leaf\n        if (indices.size() <= MAX_OCTREE_TRIS ||\n            (maxBound - minBound).norm() < MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE) {\n            triangleIndices = indices;\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // Subdivide into 8 children\n        Vec3 childHalfSize = halfExtent * 0.5f;\n        std::vector<size_t> childIndices[8];\n\n        for (size_t idx : indices) {\n            const Triangle& tri = (*allTriangles)[idx];\n\n            // Check which children this triangle overlaps\n            for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n                Vec3 childCenter = center;\n                childCenter.x += (i & 1) ? childHalfSize.x : -childHalfSize.x;\n                childCenter.y += (i & 2) ? childHalfSize.y : -childHalfSize.y;\n                childCenter.z += (i & 4) ? childHalfSize.z : -childHalfSize.z;\n\n                if (triangleBoxOverlap(childCenter, childHalfSize, tri)) {\n                    childIndices[i].push_back(idx);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Check if we can't split further (all triangles in one child)\n        bool canSplit = false;\n        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n            if (!childIndices[i].empty() && childIndices[i].size() < indices.size()) {\n                canSplit = true;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (!canSplit) {\n            triangleIndices = indices;\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // Build children\n        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n            if (!childIndices[i].empty()) {\n                Vec3 childMin = center;\n                Vec3 childMax = center;\n                childMin.x = (i & 1) ? center.x : minBound.x;\n                childMax.x = (i & 1) ? maxBound.x : center.x;\n                childMin.y = (i & 2) ? center.y : minBound.y;\n                childMax.y = (i & 2) ? maxBound.y : center.y;\n                childMin.z = (i & 4) ? center.z : minBound.z;\n                childMax.z = (i & 4) ? maxBound.z : center.z;\n\n                children[i] = std::make_unique<Octree>();\n                children[i]->allTriangles = allTriangles;\n                children[i]->buildNode(childIndices[i], childMin, childMax);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\npublic:\n    // Check if a ray intersects this node's bounding box\n    bool rayIntersectsBox(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2) const {\n        Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;\n        Vec3 c = p1 + d - center;\n        Vec3 ad = {std::abs(d.x), std::abs(d.y), std::abs(d.z)};\n\n        if (std::abs(c.x) > halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;\n        if (std::abs(c.y) > halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;\n        if (std::abs(c.z) > halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;\n\n        if (std::abs(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > halfExtent.y * ad.z + halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;\n        if (std::abs(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > halfExtent.z * ad.x + halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;\n        if (std::abs(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > halfExtent.x * ad.y + halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    // Apply a function to all triangles potentially intersecting the ray\n    // Returns true if the function returns true for any triangle\n    template<typename Func>\n    bool applyToTris(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2, Func&& func) const {\n        // If leaf node, check triangles directly\n      }\n\n        // Otherwise, descend to children\n        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n            if (children[i] && children[i]->rayIntersectsBox(p1, p2)) {\n                if (children[i]->applyToTris(p1, p2, func)) return true;\n            }\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Mesh Generation: Icosphere\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Generate an icosphere by subdividing an icosahedron\nclass IcosphereMesh {\npublic:\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n\n    IcosphereMesh(int subdivisions, val_t radius) {\n        // Initial icosahedron vertices\n        const val_t t = (1.0f + std::sqrt(5.0f)) / 2.0f;\n\n        std::vector<Vec3> vertices = {\n            Vec3(-1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius\n        };\n\n        // Initial icosahedron faces (20 triangles)\n        std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> faces = {\n            {0, 11, 5}, {0, 5, 1}, {0, 1, 7}, {0, 7, 10}, {0, 10, 11},\n            {1, 5, 9}, {5, 11, 4}, {11, 10, 2}, {10, 7, 6}, {7, 1, 8},\n            {3, 9, 4}, {3, 4, 2}, {3, 2, 6}, {3, 6, 8}, {3, 8, 9},\n            {4, 9, 5}, {2, 4, 11}, {6, 2, 10}, {8, 6, 7}, {9, 8, 1}\n        };\n\n        // Subdivide\n        for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i) {\n            std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n\n            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n\n                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n                vertices.push_back(mid);\n                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n                return idx;\n            };\n\n            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n\n                newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, c});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[1], b, a});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[2], c, b});\n                newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n            }\n            faces = std::move(newFaces);\n        }\n\n        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a \"room\")\n        triangles.reserve(faces.size());\n        for (const auto& face : faces) {\n            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n            triangles.emplace_back(vertices[face[2]], vertices[face[1]], vertices[face[0]]);\n        }\n    }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Random Number Generation\n// ============================================================================\n\nclass RandomGenerator {\n    std::mt19937 rng;\n    std::uniform_real_distribution<val_t> dist;\npublic:\n    explicit RandomGenerator(uint32_t seed = 42) : rng(seed), dist(0.0f, 1.0f) {}\n    val_t rand() { return dist(rng); }\n};\n\n// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\nVec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, RandomGenerator& rng) {\n    val_t u = rng.rand();\n    val_t v = rng.rand();\n    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n        u = 1.0f - u;\n        v = 1.0f - v;\n    }\n    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\n// ============================================================================\n\nval_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n                            const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n\n    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n// Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search\nbool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n                  const Octree& octree,\n                  size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {\n    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n\n    return octree.applyToTris(from, to, [&](size_t idx, const Triangle& tri) {\n        if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) return false;\n\n        val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n        if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {\n            return true;  // Ray is blocked\n        }\n        return false;\n    });\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Form Factor Computation (Kij)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\nval_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n    return std::max(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n}\n\n// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j (emitter)\nval_t computeKij(size_t idxI, size_t idxJ,\n                  const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles,\n                  const Octree& octree,\n                  RandomGenerator& rng) {\n    const Triangle& triI = triangles[idxI];\n    const Triangle& triJ = triangles[idxJ];\n\n    // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n    if (triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;\n\n    val_t kij = ZERO;\n\n    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);\n        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);\n\n        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, octree, idxI, idxJ)) continue;\n\n        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n\n        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n\n        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n    }\n\n    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Tau (time delay) Computation\n// ============================================================================\n\nint computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Room Response Simulation State\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct SimulationState {\n    size_t numTriangles;\n    size_t numTimesteps;\n\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n    std::vector<val_t> kij;         // Form factors (N x N matrix, row-major)\n    std::vector<int> tau;           // Time delays (N x N matrix, row-major)\n    std::vector<val_t> radE;        // Emission radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source\n\n    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n\n    size_t sourceIndex;\n\n    size_t idx2d(size_t i, size_t j) const { return i * numTriangles + j; }\n    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Initialization\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n    // Generate mesh\n    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n\n    printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n    printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n\n    // Initialize areas\n    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();\n    }\n\n    // Initialize reflectivity\n    state.rho.resize(state.numTriangles, reflectivity);\n\n    // Initialize matrices\n    state.kij.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.tau.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, 0);\n    state.radE.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.radB.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.distances.resize(state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n\n    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n    size_t timeOn = 0;\n    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n        state.radE[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)] = 1.0f;\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Precomputation Phase\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n    RandomGenerator rng(42);\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n            if (i == j) continue;\n            state.kij[state.idx2d(i, j)] = computeKij(\n                i, j, state.triangles, state.octree, rng);\n        }\n        if ((i + 1) % 100 == 0 || i + 1 == state.numTriangles) {\n            printf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", i + 1, state.numTriangles);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nvoid computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n            if (i == j) continue;\n            state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)] = computeTau(\n                state.triangles[i], state.triangles[j]);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n            val_t sumB = ZERO;\n\n            for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n                if (i == j) continue;\n\n                int tauij = state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n\n                // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i\n                if (static_cast<int>(t) < tauij) continue;\n\n                val_t kij = state.kij[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n                if (kij <= ZERO) continue;\n\n                // Get radiosity from source triangle at time when emission occurred\n                size_t srcTime = t - static_cast<size_t>(tauij);\n                val_t radJ = state.radB[state.idxTN(srcTime, j)];\n                if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n                // Accumulate contribution: form factor * area * source radiosity\n                sumB += std::min(kij * state.areas[j], ONE) * radJ;\n            }\n\n That means I need to handle the discard cost efficiently: each rank only needs draws for its own rows, so I'm calculating the starting offset per rank based on cumulative counts before it, then figuring out how to split that work across threads within a rank without forcing each thread to redundantly discard from the very start.\n\nOne option is a serial discard pass to find each thread's starting RNG state, but that cost scales with total draws per rank and could rival the actual compute time at larger scales — rough estimates put it in the same ballpark of several seconds to tens of seconds depending on rank/core counts, so it's not clearly a win. I'm leaning toward a chunked approach where I precompute RNG states at a small number of chunk boundaries using a chain of discards, parallelizing the chunks themselves to keep this overhead small relative to total compute.\n\nWithout a proper jump-ahead function, parallel discard isn't really possible since each thread depends on the previous one's ending state, so the floor cost is tied to serial discard per rank. Implementing GF(2) jump-ahead for mt19937 is doable but nontrivial — maybe around a hundred lines — and I'm trying to recall whether the characteristic polynomial needed for the known fast jump-ahead technique is readily available or whether I'd need to derive it via Berlekamp-Massey on output bits, since it isn't given directly in the standard MT19937 references.\n\nActually computing the state at an arbitrary offset requires the untempered outputs there, which we can't get without generating the sequence anyway — so this jump trick doesn't actually help. Better to just measure real numbers: check discard speed, per-pair Kij cost, core count, and whether MPI/CUDA/nvcc are even available before deciding on an approach.\n\n","time":{"start":1792976551966,"end":1792976631915},"metadata":{"anthropic":{"signature":""}}}}

small, make this a leaf\n        if (indices.size() <= MAX_OCTREE_TRIS ||\n            (maxBound - minBound).norm() < MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE) {\n            triangleIndices = indices;\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // Subdivide into 8 children\n        Vec3 childHalfSize = halfExtent * 0.5f;\n        std::vector<size_t> childIndices[8];\n\n        for (size_t idx : indices) {\n            const Triangle& tri = (*allTriangles)[idx];\n\n            // Check which children this triangle overlaps\n            for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n                Vec3 childCenter = center;\n                childCenter.x += (i & 1) ? childHalfSize.x : -childHalfSize.x;\n                childCenter.y += (i & 2) ? childHalfSize.y : -childHalfSize.y;\n                childCenter.z += (i & 4) ? childHalfSize.z : -childHalfSize.z;\n\n                if (triangleBoxOverlap(childCenter, childHalfSize, tri)) {\n                    childIndices[i].push_back(idx);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Check if we can't split further (all triangles in one child)\n        bool canSplit = false;\n        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n            if (!childIndices[i].empty() && childIndices[i].size() < indices.size()) {\n                canSplit = true;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (!canSplit) {\n            triangleIndices = indices;\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // Build children\n        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n            if (!childIndices[i].empty()) {\n                Vec3 childMin = center;\n                Vec3 childMax = center;\n                childMin.x = (i & 1) ? center.x : minBound.x;\n                childMax.x = (i & 1) ? maxBound.x : center.x;\n                childMin.y = (i & 2) ? center.y : minBound.y;\n                childMax.y = (i & 2) ? maxBound.y : center.y;\n                childMin.z = (i & 4) ? center.z : minBound.z;\n                childMax.z = (i & 4) ? maxBound.z : center.z;\n\n                children[i] = std::make_unique<Octree>();\n                children[i]->allTriangles = allTriangles;\n                children[i]->buildNode(childIndices[i], childMin, childMax);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n};\n\n// Flattened octree node used by the device traversal\nstruct FlatNode {\n    Vec3 center;\n    Vec3 halfExtent;\n    int32_t child[8];\n    int32_t triStart;\n    int32_t triCount;   // > 0 only for leaves\n};\n\nconstexpr int TRAVERSAL_STACK = 128;\n\nstatic int32_t flattenOctree(const Octree& node, int depth, std::vector<FlatNode>& nodes,\n                             std::vector<int32_t>& triIdx, int& maxDepth) {\n    maxDepth = std::max(maxDepth, depth);\n    int32_t id = static_cast<int32_t>(nodes.size());\n    FlatNode fn{};\n    fn.center = node.center;\n    fn.halfExtent = node.halfExtent;\n    for (int c = 0; c < 8; ++c) fn.child[c] = -1;\n    fn.triStart = 0;\n    fn.triCount = 0;\n    if (!node.triangleIndices.empty()) {\n        fn.triStart = static_cast<int32_t>(triIdx.size());\n        for (size_t idx : node.triangleIndices) triIdx.push_back(static_cast<int32_t>(idx));\n        fn.triCount = static_cast<int32_t>(node.triangleIndices.size());\n    }\n    nodes.push_back(fn);\n    for (int c = 0; c < 8; ++c) {\n        if (node.children[c]) {\n            int32_t cid = flattenOctree(*node.children[c], depth + 1, nodes, triIdx, maxDepth);\n            nodes[id].child[c] = cid;\n        }\n    }\n    return id;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Mersenne Twister jump-ahead (host)\n//\n// The original code draws Kij samples from std::mt19937(42) in (i, j) order, so\n// each row's draws start at a known offset in that single stream. Engine states\n// at arbitrary offsets are obtained from the output sequence alone:\n//   - Berlekamp-Massey on the low output bit recovers the linear recurrence P(x)\n//     (degree 19937) that every MT19937 output bit satisfies.\n//   - o_n = XOR over set bits i of (x^n mod P) of o_i, so the outputs at any\n//     position follow from the first 19937 outputs.\n//   - The engine state for a block of 624 outputs is the untempered outputs.\n// ============================================================================\n\nnamespace mtjump {\n\nconstexpr size_t MT_WORDS = 624;\nconstexpr uint32_t MT_SEED = 42;     // Same seed as RandomGenerator(42) in the original\nconstexpr size_t SEQ_LEN = 40130;    // Must exceed 2 * linear complexity (19937)\n\n// Undo MT19937 tempering\ninline uint32_t untemper(uint32_t y) {\n    auto unRight = [](uint32_t v, int s) {\n        uint32_t r = v;\n        for (int i = 0; i < 32 / s + 1; ++i) r = v ^ (r >> s);\n        return r;\n    };\n    auto unLeftAnd = [](uint32_t v, int s, uint32_t m) {\n        uint32_t r = v;\n        for (int i = 0; i < 32 / s + 1; ++i) r = v ^ ((r << s) & m);\n        return r;\n    };\n    y = unRight(y, 18);\n    y = unLeftAnd(y, 15, 0xefc60000u);\n    y = unLeftAnd(y, 7, 0x9d2c5680u);\n    y = unRight(y, 11);\n    return y;\n}\n\n// c ^= src << sh  (bit-packed GF(2) polynomials, same word count)\ninline void shiftXor(std::vector<uint64_t>& dst, const std::vector<uint64_t>& src, size_t sh) {\n    size_t ws = sh / 64, bs = sh % 64, W = dst.size();\n    for (size_t w = W; w-- > ws;) {\n        size_t sw = w - ws;\n        uint64_t v = src[sw] << bs;\n        if (bs && sw > 0) v |= src[sw - 1] >> (64 - bs);\n        dst[w] ^= v;\n    }\n}\n\n// Berlekamp-Massey over GF(2). Returns the linear complexity L; C holds the\n// connection polynomial (bit i = C_i, C_0 = 1).\ninline size_t berlekampMassey(const std::vector<uint8_t>& s, std::vector<uint64_t>& C) {\n    const size_t n = s.size();\n    const size_t W = n / 64 + 2;\n    std::vector<uint64_t> B(W, 0), T(W), H(W, 0);\n    C.assign(W, 0);\n    C[0] = 1;\n    B[0] = 1;\n    size_t L = 0, m = 1;\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n        // H bit i == s[k-i]\n        for (size_t w = W - 1; w > 0; --w) H[w] = (H[w] << 1) | (H[w - 1] >> 63);\n        H[0] = (H[0] << 1) | s[k];\n        uint64_t par = 0;\n        for (size_t w = 0; w < W; ++w) par ^= C[w] & H[w];\n        if (__builtin_parityll(par) == 0) {\n            ++m;\n            continue;\n        }\n        T = C;\n        shiftXor(C, B, m);\n        if (2 * L <= k) {\n            L = k + 1 - L;\n            B = T;\n            m = 1;\n        } else {\n            ++m;\n        }\n    }\n    return L;\n}\n\nstruct Jump {\n    size_t L = 0;                 // recurrence degree\n    size_t NW = 0;                // words per GF(2) polynomial (L/64 + 1)\n    std::vector<uint64_t> plow;   // x^L mod P, i.e. P(x) - x^L\n    std::vector<uint32_t> out;    // tempered outputs o_0 .. o_{SEQ_LEN-1}\n};\n\ninline Jump buildJump() {\n    std::mt19937 eng(MT_SEED);\n    Jump J;\n    J.out.resize(SEQ_LEN);\n    for (auto& v : J.out) v = eng();\n\n    std::vector<uint8_t> bits(SEQ_LEN);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < SEQ_LEN; ++i) bits[i] = static_cast<uint8_t>(J.out[i] & 1u);\n\n    std::vector<uint64_t> C;\n    J.L = berlekampMassey(bits, C);\n    if (2 * J.L > SEQ_LEN) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"mtjump: recurrence degree %zu not determined by %zu outputs\\n\", J.L, SEQ_LEN);\n        std::abort();\n    }\n\n    J.NW = J.L / 64 + 1;\n    J.plow.assign(J.NW, 0);\n    // P(x) = sum_i C_i x^(L-i); plow bit k = C_{L-k} for k < L\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < J.L; ++k) {\n        size_t i = J.L - k;\n        if ((C[i / 64] >> (i % 64)) & 1ULL) J.plow[k / 64] |= 1ULL << (k % 64);\n    }\n    return J;\n}\n\n// a <- a * x mod P\ninline void mulX(const Jump& J, std::vector<uint64_t>& a) {\n    uint64_t carry = 0;\n    for (size_t w = 0; w < J.NW; ++w) {\n        uint64_t nc = a[w] >> 63;\n        a[w] = (a[w] << 1) | carry;\n        carry = nc;\n    }\n    size_t wl = J.L / 64, bl = J.L % 64;\n    if ((a[wl] >> bl) & 1ULL) {\n        a[wl] &= ~(1ULL << bl);\n        for (size_t w = 0; w < J.NW; ++w) a[w] ^= J.plow[w];\n    }\n}\n\n// a^2 mod P (squaring is linear over GF(2): spread bits, then reduce)\ninline std::vector<uint64_t> squareMod(const Jump& J, const std::vector<uint64_t>& a) {\n    const size_t R = 2 * J.NW + 2;\n    std::vector<uint64_t> t(R, 0);\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < J.L; ++k) {\n        if ((a[k / 64] >> (k % 64)) & 1ULL) {\n            size_t p = 2 * k;\n            t[p / 64] |= 1ULL << (p % 64);\n        }\n    }\n    for (int64_t k = 2 * static_cast<int64_t>(J.L) - 2; k >= static_cast<int64_t>(J.L); --k) {\n        if ((t[k / 64] >> (k % 64)) & 1ULL) {\n            t[k / 64] &= ~(1ULL << (k % 64));\n            size_t s = static_cast<size_t>(k) - J.L;\n            size_t ws = s / 64, bs = s % 64;\n            for (size_t w = 0; w < J.NW; ++w) {\n                uint64_t v = J.plow[w];\n                if (!v) continue;\n                t[w + ws] ^= v << bs;\n                if (bs) t[w + ws + 1] ^= v >> (64 - bs);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return std::vector<uint64_t>(t.begin(), t.begin() + J.NW);\n}\n\n// x^m mod P\ninline std::vector<uint64_t> powX(const Jump& J, uint64_t m) {\n    std::vector<uint64_t> r(J.NW, 0);\n    r[0] = 1;\n    if (m == 0) return r;\n    int hi = 63 - __builtin_clzll(m);\n    bool first = true;\n    for (int b = hi; b >= 0; --b) {\n        if (!first) r = squareMod(J, r);\n        first = false;\n        if ((m >> b) & 1ULL) mulX(J, r);\n    }\n    return r;\n}\n\n// Engine words (post-twist state) for output block `block`, i.e. outputs\n// [624*block, 624*block + 624). Consumers then start at index r within the block.\ninline void stateForBlock(const Jump& J, uint64_t block, uint32_t* words) {\n    std::vector<uint64_t> cur = powX(J, MT_WORDS * block);\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < MT_WORDS; ++j) {\n        uint32_t acc = 0;\n        for (size_t w = 0; w < J.NW; ++w) {\n            uint64_t x = cur[w];\n            while (x) {\n                acc ^= J.out[w * 64 + static_cast<size_t>(__builtin_ctzll(x))];\n                x &= x - 1;\n            }\n        }\n        words[j] = untemper(acc);\n        mulX(J, cur);\n    }\n}\n\n}  // namespace mtjump\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Device-side geometry and RNG\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Ray-box test (same arithmetic as the original Octree::rayIntersectsBox)\nHD inline bool rayBoxHit(const Vec3& center, const Vec3& halfExtent, const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2) {\n    Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;\n    Vec3 c = p1 + d - center;\n    Vec3 ad = {fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z)};\n\n    if (fabsf(c.x) > halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;\n    if (fabsf(c.y) > halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;\n    if (fabsf(c.z) > halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;\n\n    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > halfExtent.y * ad.z + halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;\n    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > halfExtent.z * ad.x + halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;\n    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > halfExtent.x * ad.y + halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Moller-Trumbore ray-triangle intersection\nHD inline val_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n                                     const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n\n    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return VAL_MAX;\n\n    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return VAL_MAX;\n\n    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return VAL_MAX;\n\n    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n}\n\n// Cosine between vector and normal (clamped at zero)\nHD inline val_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n    return vmax(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n}\n\n// MT19937 tempering and in-place twist (identical to libstdc++ std::mt19937)\nDEVICE_FN uint32_t mtTemper(uint32_t y) {\n    y ^= y >> 11;\n    y ^= (y << 7) & 0x9d2c5680u;\n    y ^= (y << 15) & 0xefc60000u;\n    y ^= y >> 18;\n    return y;\n}\n\nDEVICE_FN void mtTwist(uint32_t* mt) {\n    for (int k = 0; k < 624; ++k) {\n        uint32_t y = (mt[k] & 0x80000000u) | (mt[(k + 1) % 624] & 0x7fffffffu);\n        mt[k] = mt[(k + 397) % 624] ^ (y >> 1) ^ ((y & 1u) ? 0x9908b0dfu : 0u);\n    }\n}\n\n// Equivalent of std::uniform_real_distribution<float>(0,1)(std::mt19937&)\n// (libstdc++ consumes exactly one 32-bit draw per value for float/mt19937).\nDEVICE_FN val_t mtUniform(uint32_t* st, int& p) {\n    if (p >= 624) {\n        mtTwist(st);\n        p = 0;\n    }\n    uint32_t y = mtTemper(st[p++]);\n    val_t ret = static_cast<val_t>(y) / 4294967296.0f;\n    if (ret >= 1.0f) ret = 0.99999994f;  // nextafter(1, 0)\n    return ret;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Device Ray Tracing and Form Factors\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Octree traversal for the visibility test (boolean result, so traversal order\n// does not affect the answer; the same triangles are tested as in the original)\nDEVICE_FN bool isRayBlockedDev(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n                               const Triangle* tris, const FlatNode* nodes, const int32_t* triIdx,\n                               int32_t srcIdx, int32_t dstIdx) {\n    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n\n    int32_t stack[TRAVERSAL_STACK];\n    int sp = 0;\n    stack[sp++] = 0;\n    while (sp > 0) {\n        const FlatNode& nd = nodes[stack[--sp]];\n        if (nd.triCount > 0) {\n            for (int k = 0; k < nd.triCount; ++k) {\n                int32_t idx = triIdx[nd.triStart + k];\n                if (idx == srcIdx || idx == dstIdx) continue;\n                const Triangle& tri = tris[idx];\n                val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n                if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) return true;\n            }\n        } else {\n            for (int c = 0; c < 8; ++c) {\n                int32_t ch = nd.child[c];\n                if (ch >= 0 && rayBoxHit(nodes[ch].center, nodes[ch].halfExtent, from, to)) {\n                    stack[sp++] = ch;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return false;\n}\n\nDEVICE_FN Vec3 randomPointInTriangleDev(const Triangle& t, uint32_t* st, int& p) {\n    val_t u = mtUniform(st, p);\n    val_t v = mtUniform(st, p);\n    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n        u = 1.0f - u;\n        v = 1.0f - v;\n    }\n    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n}\n\n// Form factor Kij between receiver i and emitter j. Consumes exactly 4 draws per\n// ray, and no draws for culled pairs, matching the original sequential stream.\nDEVICE_FN val_t computeKijDev(int i, int j, const Triangle* tris, const FlatNode* nodes,\n                              const int32_t* triIdx, uint32_t* st, int& p) {\n    const Triangle& triI = tris[i];\n    const Triangle& triJ = tris[j];\n\n    // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n    if (triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;\n\n    val_t kij = ZERO;\n    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangleDev(triI, st, p);\n        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangleDev(triJ, st, p);\n\n        if (isRayBlockedDev(pI, pJ, tris, nodes, triIdx, i, j)) continue;\n\n        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n\n        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n\n        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n    }\n    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Kernels\n// ============================================================================\n\n// One thread per locally owned receiver row. Each thread walks its row's emitters\n// in order, continuing the row's own random stream (starting at states[li], index startIdx[li]).\n__global__ void kijKernel(const Triangle* __restrict__ tris, const FlatNode* __restrict__ nodes,\n                          const int32_t* __restrict__ triIdx, const uint32_t* __restrict__ states,\n                          const int32_t* __restrict__ startIdx, int N, int i0, int nLocal,\n                          float* __restrict__ kij) {\n    int li = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (li >= nLocal) return;\n    int i = i0 + li;\n\n    uint32_t st[mtjump::MT_WORDS];\n    for (int k = 0; k < static_cast<int>(mtjump::MT_WORDS); ++k) {\n        st[k] = states[static_cast<size_t>(li) * mtjump::MT_WORDS + k];\n    }\n    int p = startIdx[li];\n\n    float* row = kij + static_cast<size_t>(li) * N;\n    for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n        row[j] = (j == i) ? ZERO : computeKijDev(i, j, tris, nodes, triIdx, st, p);\n    }\n}\n\n// Time delays Tau(i, j) = ceil(|c_i - c_j| / WAVE_SPEED) for locally owned rows\n__global__ void tauKernel(const Triangle* __restrict__ tris, int N, int i0, int nLocal,\n                          int32_t* __restrict__ tau) {\n    int li = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (li >= nLocal) return;\n    int i = i0 + li;\n    Vec3 ci = tris[i].center();\n    int32_t* row = tau + static_cast<size_t>(li) * N;\n    for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n        if (j == i) {\n            row[j] = 0;\n            continue;\n        }\n        val_t dist = (ci - tris[j].center()).norm();\n        row[j] = static_cast<int32_t>(ceilf(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n    }\n}\n\n// Wave propagation for one timestep t, for locally owned receivers.\n// Each thread sums over emitters in the same order as the original code.\n__global__ void simulateStepKernel(int t, int N, int i0, int nLocal, int src, int timeOff,\n                                   const float* __restrict__ kijL, const int32_t* __restrict__ tauL,\n                                   const float* __restrict__ areas, float rho,\n                                   float* __restrict__ radB) {\n    int li = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (li >= nLocal) return;\n    int i = i0 + li;\n    const float* kRow = kijL + static_cast<size_t>(li) * N;\n    const int32_t* tRow = tauL + static_cast<size_t>(li) * N;\n\n    float sumB = ZERO;\n    for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n        if (j == i) continue;\n\n        int tauij = tRow[j];\n        // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i\n        if (t < tauij) continue;\n\n        float kij = kRow[j];\n        if (kij <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        size_t srcTime = static_cast<size_t>(t) - static_cast<size_t>(tauij);\n        float radJ = radB[srcTime * N + j];\n        if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        sumB += vmin(kij * areas[j], ONE) * radJ;\n    }\n\n    // Emission from the source (active for first half of timesteps)\n    float radE = (t < timeOff && i == src) ? ONE : ZERO;\n    radB[static_cast<size_t>(t) * N + i] = rho * sumB + radE;\n}\n\n// Count entries above EPSILON (validation)\n__global__ void countNonZeroKernel(const float* __restrict__ kij, size_t n,\n                                   unsigned long long* __restrict__ count) {\n    size_t stride = static_cast<size_t>(gridDim.x) * blockDim.x;\n    unsigned long long local = 0;\n    for (size_t k = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; k < n; k += stride) {\n        if (kij[k] > EPSILON) ++local;\n    }\n    if (local) atomicAdd(count, local);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Mesh Generation: Icosphere\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Generate an icosphere by subdividing an icosahedron\nclass IcosphereMesh {\npublic:\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n\n    IcosphereMesh(int subdivisions, val_t radius) {\n        // Initial icosahedron vertices\n        const val_t t = (1.0f + std::sqrt(5.0f)) / 2.0f;\n\n        std::vector<Vec3> vertices = {\n            Vec3(-1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius\n        };\n\n        // Initial icosahedron faces (20 triangles)\n        std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> faces = {\n            {0, 11, 5}, {0, 5, 1}, {0, 1, 7}, {0, 7, 10}, {0, 10, 11},\n            {1, 5, 9}, {5, 11, 4}, {11, 10, 2}, {10, 7, 6}, {7, 1, 8},\n            {3, 9, 4}, {3, 4, 2}, {3, 2, 6}, {3, 6, 8}, {3, 8, 9},\n            {4, 9, 5}, {2, 4, 11}, {6, 2, 10}, {8, 6, 7}, {9, 8, 1}\n        };\n\n        // Subdivide\n        for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i) {\n            std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n\n            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n\n                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n                vertices.push_back(mid);\n                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n                return idx;\n            };\n\n            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n\n                newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, c});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[1], b, a});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[2], c, b});\n                newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n            }\n            faces = std::move(newFaces);\n        }\n\n        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a \"room\")\n        triangles.reserve(faces.size());\n        for (const auto& face : faces) {\n            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n            triangles.emplace_back(vertices[face[2]], vertices[face[1]], vertices[face[0]]);\n        }\n    }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Room Response Simulation State\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Row partition of receiver triangles over MPI ranks\nstruct Partition {\n    std::vector<int> counts;   // rows per rank\n    std::vector<int> displs;   // first row per rank\n    int i0 = 0;                // first local row\n    int nLocal = 0;            // number of local rows\n};\n\nstatic Partition makePartition(size_t N) {\n    Partition p;\n    p.counts.resize(g_size);\n    p.displs.resize(g_size);\n    int base = static_cast<int>(N) / g_size;\n    int rem = static_cast<int>(N) % g_size;\n    int off = 0;\n    for (int r = 0; r < g_size; ++r) {\n        p.counts[r] = base + (r < rem ? 1 : 0);\n        p.displs[r] = off;\n        off += p.counts[r];\n    }\n    p.i0 = p.displs[g_rank];\n    p.nLocal = p.counts[g_rank];\n    return p;\n}\n\nstruct SimulationState {\n    size_t numTriangles;\n    size_t numTimesteps;\n\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n    val_t reflectivity;\n    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N, full, all ranks)\n    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source\n\n    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n    std::vector<FlatNode> flatNodes;\n    std::vector<int32_t> flatTriIdx;\n    int maxOctreeDepth = 0;\n\n    size_t sourceIndex;\n\n    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n};\n\n// Device-resident data owned by this rank\nstruct DeviceContext {\n    Triangle* tris = nullptr;\n    FlatNode* nodes = nullptr;\n    int32_t* triIdx = nullptr;\n    float* areas = nullptr;\n    uint32_t* mtStates = nullptr;   // nLocal x 624\n    int32_t* mtIndex = nullptr;     // nLocal\n    float* kij = nullptr;           // nLocal x N\n    int32_t* tau = nullptr;         // nLocal x N\n    float* radB = nullptr;          // T x N\n};\n\nstatic void* allocDevice(size_t bytes) {\n    void* ptr = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&ptr, bytes > 0 ? bytes : 1));\n    return ptr;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Initialization\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n    // Generate mesh\n    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n    state.reflectivity = reflectivity;\n\n    RPRINTF(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n    RPRINTF(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n\n    state.flatNodes.clear();\n    state.flatTriIdx.clear();\n    state.maxOctreeDepth = 0;\n    flattenOctree(state.octree, 0, state.flatNodes, state.flatTriIdx, state.maxOctreeDepth);\n    if (1 + 8 * state.maxOctreeDepth > TRAVERSAL_STACK) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"Octree too deep for device traversal stack\\n\");\n        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n    }\n\n    // Initialize areas\n    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();\n    }\n\n    // Initialize radiosity history (zero-filled, filled during simulation)\n    state.radB.assign(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.distances.assign(state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Precomputation Phase\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Upload geometry and the octree to this rank's GPU\nstatic void uploadGeometry(DeviceContext& dev, const SimulationState& state) {\n    size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&dev.tris), N * sizeof(Triangle)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dev.tris, state.triangles.data(), N * sizeof(Triangle), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    dev.nodes = static_cast<FlatNode*>(allocDevice(state.flatNodes.size() * sizeof(FlatNode)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dev.nodes, state.flatNodes.data(), state.flatNodes.size() * sizeof(FlatNode),\n                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    dev.triIdx = static_cast<int32_t*>(allocDevice(state.flatTriIdx.size() * sizeof(int32_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dev.triIdx, state.flatTriIdx.data(), state.flatTriIdx.size() * sizeof(int32_t),\n                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    dev.areas = static_cast<float*>(allocDevice(N * sizeof(float)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dev.areas, state.areas.data(), N * sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n}\n\n// Stream offset for each receiver row in the original sequential draw order.\n// Row i starts after all draws of rows < i; a non-culled pair consumes 4 draws per ray.\nstatic void computeRowStarts(const std::vector<Triangle>& tris, std::vector<uint64_t>& rowDraws) {\n    const size_t N = tris.size();\n    std::vector<uint64_t> cnt(N, 0);\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 16)\n    for (long long i = 0; i < static_cast<long long>(N); ++i) {\n        const Triangle& triI = tris[i];\n        uint64_t c = 0;\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            if (j == static_cast<size_t>(i)) continue;\n            if (!(triI.normal().dot(tris[j].normal()) > 0.99f)) ++c;\n        }\n        cnt[i] = c;\n    }\n    rowDraws.assign(N + 1, 0);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        rowDraws[i + 1] = rowDraws[i] + cnt[i] * static_cast<uint64_t>(4 * NUM_RAYS);\n    }\n}\n\n// Tau on the device (only the local rows)\nstatic void computeTimeDelays(const SimulationState& state, DeviceContext& dev, const Partition& part) {\n    RPRINTF(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n    size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    dev.tau = static_cast<int32_t*>(allocDevice(static_cast<size_t>(part.nLocal) * N * sizeof(int32_t)));\n    if (part.nLocal > 0) {\n        int block = 128;\n        int grid = (part.nLocal + block - 1) / block;\n        tauKernel<<<grid, block>>>(dev.tris, static_cast<int>(N), part.i0, part.nLocal, dev.tau);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n    }\n}\n\n// Form factors on the device, one thread per local row. The RNG state for each row\n// is computed on the host (OpenMP) by jump-ahead into the single original stream.\nstatic void computeFormFactors(const SimulationState& state, DeviceContext& dev, const Partition& part,\n                               const mtjump::Jump& jump) {\n    RPRINTF(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n    size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n\n    std::vector<uint64_t> rowDraws;\n    computeRowStarts(state.triangles, rowDraws);\n\n    // Per-row engine state at the row's first draw\n    std::vector<uint32_t> hStates(static_cast<size_t>(part.nLocal) * mtjump::MT_WORDS);\n    std::vector<int32_t> hIndex(part.nLocal);\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 1)\n    for (int li = 0; li < part.nLocal; ++li) {\n        uint64_t off = rowDraws[part.i0 + li];\n        uint64_t block = off / mtjump::MT_WORDS;\n        hIndex[li] = static_cast<int32_t>(off % mtjump::MT_WORDS);\n        mtjump::stateForBlock(jump, block, &hStates[static_cast<size_t>(li) * mtjump::MT_WORDS]);\n    }\n\n    dev.mtStates = static_cast<uint32_t*>(allocDevice(hStates.size() * sizeof(uint32_t)));\n    dev.mtIndex = static_cast<int32_t*>(allocDevice(hIndex.size() * sizeof(int32_t)));\n    dev.kij = static_cast<float*>(allocDevice(static_cast<size_t>(part.nLocal) * N * sizeof(float)));\n    if (part.nLocal > 0) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dev.mtStates, hStates.data(), hStates.size() * sizeof(uint32_t),\n                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dev.mtIndex, hIndex.data(), hIndex.size() * sizeof(int32_t),\n                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n        int block = 128;\n        int grid = (part.nLocal + block - 1) / block;\n        kijKernel<<<grid, block>>>(dev.tris, dev.nodes, dev.triIdx, dev.mtStates, dev.mtIndex,\n                                   static_cast<int>(N), part.i0, part.nLocal, dev.kij);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n    }\n    RPRINTF(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", N, N);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state, DeviceContext& dev, const Partition& part) {\n    RPRINTF(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n    size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    int T = static_cast<int>(state.numTimesteps);\n    int timeOff = T / 2;  // source emits during the first half of the timesteps\n    int src = static_cast<int>(state.sourceIndex);\n    val_t rho = state.reflectivity;\n\n    dev.radB = static_cast<float*>(allocDevice(static_cast<size_t>(T) * N * sizeof(float)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(dev.radB, 0, static_cast<size_t>(T) * N * sizeof(float)));\n\n    std::vector<float> hSend(part.nLocal > 0 ? part.nLocal : 1);\n    int block = 128;\n    int grid = (part.nLocal + block - 1) / block;\n\n    for (int t = 0; t < T; ++t) {\n        if (part.nLocal > 0) {\n            simulateStepKernel<<<grid, block>>>(t, static_cast<int>(N), part.i0, part.nLocal, src,\n                                                timeOff, dev.kij, dev.tau, dev.areas, rho, dev.radB);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hSend.data(), dev.radB + static_cast<size_t>(t) * N + part.i0,\n                                  static_cast<size_t>(part.nLocal) * sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n        }\n\n        // Share this timestep's radiosity row among all ranks\n        MPI_Allgatherv(hSend.data(), part.nLocal, MPI_FLOAT, state.radB.data() + static_cast<size_t>(t) * N,\n                       part.counts.data(), part.displs.data(), MPI_FLOAT, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dev.radB + static_cast<size_t>(t) * N,\n                              state.radB.data() + static_cast<size_t>(t) * N, N * sizeof(float),\n                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n        if ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == T) {\n            RPRINTF(\"  Timestep %d/%d\\n\", t + 1, T);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeDistances(SimulationState& state, const Partition& part) {\n    RPRINTF(\"Computing distances via cross-correlation...\\n\");\n    size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    size_t T = state.numTimesteps;\n    size_t src = state.sourceIndex;\n\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (int li = 0; li < part.nLocal; ++li) {\n        size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(part.i0 + li);\n        val_t maxCorr = ZERO;\n        int bestT = 0;\n\n        // Discrete cross-correlation to find time delay\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < T; ++t) {\n            val_t sum = ZERO;\n\n            for (size_t tt = t; tt < T; ++tt) {\n                val_t pB = state.radB[tt * N + i];\n                val_t pS = state.radB[(tt - t) * N + src];\n                sum += pS * pB;\n            }\n\n            if (sum > maxCorr) {\n                maxCorr = sum;\n                bestT = static_cast<int>(t);\n            }\n        }\n\n        state.distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestT);\n    }\n\n    MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_DATATYPE_NULL, state.distances.data(),\n                   part.counts.data(), part.displs.data(), MPI_FLOAT, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Validation\n// ============================================================================\n\nbool validateResults(const SimulationState& state, unsigned long long nonZeroKij) {\n    RPRINTF(\"\\nValidation:\\n\");\n\n    // Check that distances are non-negative\n    bool allNonNegative = true;\n    val_t minDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n    val_t maxDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();\n    val_t sumDist = ZERO;\n    int nonZeroCount = 0;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        val_t d = state.distances[i];\n        if (d < 0) {\n            allNonNegative = false;\n            RPRINTF(\"  ERROR: Negative distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n        }\n        if (!std::isfinite(d)) {\n            RPRINTF(\"  ERROR: Non-finite distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n            return false;\n        }\n        minDist = std::min(minDist, d);\n        maxDist = std::max(maxDist, d);\n        sumDist += d;\n        if (d > EPSILON) nonZeroCount++;\n    }\n\n    RPRINTF(\"  Distance range: [%.4f, %.4f]\\n\", minDist, maxDist);\n    RPRINTF(\"  Average distance: %.4f\\n\", sumDist / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles));\n    RPRINTF(\"  Non-zero distances: %d/%zu\\n\", nonZeroCount, state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Check source distance is zero or very small\n    val_t srcDist = state.distances[state.sourceIndex];\n    if (srcDist > WAVE_SPEED * 2) {\n        RPRINTF(\"  WARNING: Source triangle distance is non-zero: %.4f\\n\", srcDist);\n    }\n\n    // Check radiosity propagation (some triangles should have received energy)\n    int receivedEnergy = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n            if (state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] > EPSILON) {\n                receivedEnergy++;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    RPRINTF(\"  Triangles receiving energy: %d/%zu\\n\", receivedEnergy, state.numTriangles);\n\n    if (receivedEnergy == 0) {\n        RPRINTF(\"  ERROR: No triangles received energy - simulation failed\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    // Check Kij matrix (should have some non-zero entries)\n    size_t totalKij = state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles;\n    RPRINTF(\"  Non-zero form factors: %llu/%zu (%.2f%%)\\n\",\n            nonZeroKij, totalKij,\n            100.0f * static_cast<val_t>(nonZeroKij) / static_cast<val_t>(totalKij));\n\n    if (nonZeroKij == 0) {\n        RPRINTF(\"  ERROR: All form factors are zero - visibility computation failed\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    if (!allNonNegative) {\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    RPRINTF(\"  Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n    return true;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Hash for Verification\n// ============================================================================\n\nuint64_t computeHash(const SimulationState& state) {\n    uint64_t hash = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        const uint32_t* ptr = reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(&state.distances[i]);\n        hash ^= (static_cast<uint64_t>(*ptr) + i) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;\n    }\n    return hash;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Helper: Compute subdivision level from target triangle count\n// ============================================================================\n\nint getSubdivisionsForTriangleCount(int targetTriangles) {\n    // Icosphere: 20 triangles initially, 4x per subdivision\n    // subdivisions: 0->20, 1->80, 2->320, 3->1280, 4->5120, 5->20480\n    int subdivisions = 0;\n    int triangles = 20;\n    while (triangles < targetTriangles && subdivisions < 6) {\n        subdivisions++;\n        triangles *= 4;\n    }\n    return subdivisions;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Main\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Target number of triangles (default: 320)\\n\");\n    printf(\"               Actual count will be rounded to nearest icosphere level:\\n\");\n    printf(\"               20, 80, 320, 1280, 5120, 20480\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <num>     Number of timesteps (default: 50)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Source triangle index (default: 0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r <val>     Reflectivity 0.0-1.0 (default: 0.8)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -o           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nstatic int runBenchmark(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int targetTriangles = 320;\n    int timesteps = 50;\n    int sourceIdx = 0;\n    val_t reflectivity = 0.8f;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            targetTriangles = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            timesteps = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-s\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            sourceIdx = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            reflectivity = static_cast<val_t>(atof(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-o\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (g_rank == 0) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (g_rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    int subdivisions = getSubdivisionsForTriangleCount(targetTriangles);\n\n    // Bind this rank to a GPU (ranks on a node are spread round-robin over its GPUs)\n    int numDevices = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&numDevices));\n    if (numDevices == 0) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"[rank %d] roomsim requires at least one CUDA device\\n\", g_rank);\n        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n    }\n    MPI_Comm localComm;\n    MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, g_rank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &localComm);\n    int localRank = 0, localSize = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(localComm, &localRank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(localComm, &localSize);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(localRank % numDevices));\n    MPI_Comm_free(&localComm);\n\n    // Share host cores between co-located ranks\n    int cores = omp_get_num_procs();\n    omp_set_num_threads(std::max(1, cores / localSize));\n\n    RPRINTF(\"Room Response Simulation Benchmark\\n\");\n    RPRINTF(\"===================================\\n\");\n    RPRINTF(\"Target triangles: %d (using %d subdivisions)\\n\", targetTriangles, subdivisions);\n    RPRINTF(\"Timesteps: %d\\n\", timesteps);\n    RPRINTF(\"Source triangle: %d\\n\", sourceIdx);\n    RPRINTF(\"Reflectivity: %.2f\\n\", reflectivity);\n    RPRINTF(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    RPRINTF(\"MPI ranks: %d, OpenMP threads per rank: %d, GPUs per node in use: %d\\n\",\n            g_size, omp_get_max_threads(), std::min(localSize, numDevices));\n    RPRINTF(\"\\n\");\n\n    // Initialize\n    SimulationState state;\n    initializeSimulation(state, subdivisions, static_cast<size_t>(timesteps),\n                         static_cast<size_t>(sourceIdx), reflectivity);\n\n    size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    Partition part = makePartition(N);\n\n    RPRINTF(\"\\n\");\n\n    DeviceContext dev;\n    uploadGeometry(dev, state);\n\n    // Random-stream jump table (shared read-only by all OpenMP threads)\n    mtjump::Jump jump = mtjump::buildJump();\n\n    // Precomputation\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    double startPre = MPI_Wtime();\n\n    computeTimeDelays(state, dev, {"type":"reasoning","timestamp":1792977385139,"sessionID":"ses_e8a452045ffe8CnrxsgepPtYJG","part":{"id":"prt_175c72850001MLXEc4WniAPc5T","messageID":"msg_175c722e0001bbLal5aeijTxpq","sessionID":"ses_e8a452045ffe8CnrxsgepPtYJG","type":"reasoning","text":"The 5120-row run took 13.4s precomputation but 12m42s of user CPU time, suggesting the host-side jump computation is the real bottleneck—roughly 75ms per row adds up fast across thousands of rows, and the 1280 run's 2m24s user time confirms this scaling pattern.\n\nI'm trying to figure out where that per-row cost comes from: likely the squaring loop in powX, which does ~36 squarings each requiring a bit-scan and reduction over the set high bits—that alone could account for most of the ~0.1s per row, while the smaller mulX/XOR loop over 624 words is comparatively cheap. I'm now considering ways to cut this cost, either by exploiting the relationship between consecutive rows' offsets to avoid redundant powX calls, or by speeding up the squaring reduction itself.\n\nI'm considering stepping between consecutive rows within a thread by multiplying by x^d_i rather than recomputing from scratch, but a general modular multiplication costs as much as squaring, so trying to use repeated cheap mulX steps instead turns out too expensive since d_i itself can be hundreds of thousands, blowing up the total operation count.\n\nGiven that per-row squaring cost times 5120 rows adds up to hundreds of CPU-seconds, I'm now considering precomputing a table of x^(2^k) mod P values once and using sparse multiplication based on the bit pattern of each exponent, but this still ends up costing roughly as much as straightforward squaring due to the number of terms needed, so it isn't a clear win.\n\nThinking about generating the 624-word output block directly via the linear recurrence instead of via polynomial powers, but that approach costs about the same order of operations, so the real issue is likely implementation inefficiency in the squaring and reduction loops rather than an asymptotic one, since current timings are an order of magnitude worse than the theoretical operation count suggests.\n\nI consider whether to speed up reduction by operating on whole words instead of bits, using precomputed shift tables, or by exploiting sequential row ordering so each thread can advance its state incrementally rather than recomputing large jumps from scratch for every row.\n\nThis leads me to think about using PCLMUL for carry-less polynomial multiplication — roughly 97k pclmul operations per full multiply, plus a comparable Barrett reduction cost, which could make each squaring dramatically faster than the current bit-by-bit approach.\n\nFor N=5120, that's about 36 seconds of CPU time total, which spreads nicely across 256 cores to under a second — acceptable, though I need to verify PCLMUL is reliably available given the -march=native build flag already in use. I'm also considering whether a more portable Karatsuba-style approach using 64-bit multiplies could work instead, though carry-less multiplication without PCLMUL requires non-trivial bit-spreading tricks.\n\nStepping back, maybe I should attack the algorithmic scale directly rather than optimize the per-row jump: options include reducing dense polynomial cost via Montgomery-style reduction, restructuring rows into contiguous groups so GPU threads derive starting states from neighbors (though this breaks parallelism since GPU can't jump sequentially), or exploiting the fact that only certain blocks need full state recomputation. Another angle is a hybrid scheme where each thread computes its first row's state via exponentiation, then advances through subsequent rows by running the sequential generator forward for the gap between row offsets.\n\nThat discard-forward approach turns out to be much cheaper than repeated jumps: generating draws sequentially through each row's offset gap costs only nanoseconds per draw, so a full thread's total workload scales with its share of the total stream length. Estimating for N=5120 and N=20480 with hundreds of threads per host, the total cost comes out to tens of milliseconds to a fraction of a second — dramatically better than redoing jump computations per row, provided I can still recover the exact state needed at the start of each row.\n\nRather than relying on slow string serialization of the generator's internal state, I realize I should implement my own compact MT19937 engine where the state is just the 624-word array plus an index, letting me copy it cheaply at each row start. So the plan becomes: for each thread's contiguous block of rows, jump once to the block's starting state, then walk forward row by row, snapshotting the 624-word state before advancing through that row's exact number of discarded draws.\n\nSince the engine only needs to reach the correct state (not output actual numbers), advancing by n draws just means twisting whole 624-word blocks as needed, which costs roughly 1ns per draw — negligible even for huge draw counts, so contiguous static row-chunk scheduling across threads should work fine.\n\nWriting twist logic...\n\nSo the engine's untempered words feed correctly into the tempering, producing consistent y-values. This means per-thread work is just one power computation plus state advance per block, removing the costly O(N) jumps — though for small N like 320, the single power computation (~100ms in parallel across threads) still dominates compared to the ~25ms Baum-Welch cost.\n\nI'm also considering the per-thread costs: the state initialization loop is fast since it only runs once per thread, and the squaring operation is similarly cheap when done once. The bigger question is the row-starts computation, which scales as N² dot products — worth measuring at larger N since it's trivial at smaller scales. I'm restructuring the form factors computation to use the thread-chunk approach, setting up a host Mersenne Twister structure with twist and advance-draws functions in a jump-ahead namespace.\n\nWriting twist function...\n\nThen I'm parallelizing the form factor computation across threads, dividing the local row range among them, jumping each thread's state to its starting offset using the block and phase calculation, copying the resulting state into per-row storage, and advancing the state incrementally for each subsequent row within that thread's chunk.\n\nChecking correctness: the running state and index are properly threaded through each row's advance call, the array bounds for row draws stay within the valid size, and the total twist cost per row scales reasonably even for large draw counts. This looks solid, so I'll apply the change.\n\n","time":{"start":1792977348688,"end":1792977385034},"metadata":{"anthropic":{"signature":""}}}}
